memberships.page_title: Resolvent Restrictions on a Cubic Normalization Defect

statement: Let a complete normal Cohen-Macaulay threefold resolvent germ admit a proper birational regular model with one exceptional prime Cartier divisor over a smooth curve and a regular transverse surface slice. If the scheme-theoretic exceptional fiber is a plane cubic C with O_C(-E)=O_C(1), then every rank-one reflexive sheaf L with L^[3]=O is maximal Cohen-Macaulay; under the cubic-resolvent reduction, the associated cubic normalization is flat.
title: The Regular One-Divisor Plane-Cubic Axis Resolvent Model Is Flat
